subject: Walkling Court Planned Development District
overview: The board voted to recommend a Planned Development District zoning amendment for the redevelopment of Walkling Court into affordable housing, approved a site plan for a mixed-use development at 421–423 High Street with conditions, and postponed a drive-thru permit for Bank of America.

items.title: Special Permit for Drive-Thru at 3850 Mystic Valley Parkway
items.summary: Postponed the hearing to September 20, 2023, after the plaza representative raised unresolved concerns regarding tenant parking approvals.

items.title: Planned Development District Zoning Amendment for 1–20 Walkling Court
items.summary: Voted to recommend the draft PDD-3 zoning amendment to the City Council to facilitate the Medford Housing Authority's redevelopment of the site into 238 deeply affordable units.

items.title: Site Plan Review for 421–423 High Street
items.summary: Approved the site plan for a four-story, nine-unit residential building with ground-floor commercial space, subject to conditions including vehicle warning sensors, two smart meters, and department head comments.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Approved the minutes of June 21, 2023, and briefly discussed upcoming board business and submission deadlines.
